row.notes: Virtual (vtable slot 0x145644fd0) completion handler of an F1OS-TASKSYSTEM Steam store request: matches request id param_1[0x27] with param_2[0], on failure posts 'An error occurred when communicating with Steam.' (0x1432c0280 code 2); else parses Steam appdetails JSON {<appid>:{success,data:{price_overview:{currency,final,final_formatted,initial_formatted}}}} and fills price entries via 0x140968790 into list param_1[0x25]; logs 'setting finished on %s : %s' OK!/with error; sets done byte +0xa1. Addon: read DLC/store prices the game shows; know when store price fetch finished.
